message.content:
This is a fix for a heap-buffer-overflow READ in vcf.c. The bug is in `bcf_dec_typed_int1_safe`. The check `end - p < bcf_type_shift[t]` should be `end - p < (1<<bcf_type_shift[t])`. 

`bcf_type_shift[t]` is a shift amount (e.g., 0 for int8, 1 for int16, 2 for int32). The check was comparing against the shift value instead of the actual byte size `1<<shift`. So for int16 (shift=1), it would only check that `end - p >= 1` instead of `>= 2`, allowing a read of 2 bytes when only 1 byte remains, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ 2 (or READ 4 for int32).
